outcome: Relative abundance of viruses at the order, family, and genus levels
Viral α diversity and β diversity
cohort: 11 children with ASD and 12 healthy non-ASD children (from 13 families), aged 3-11 years
finding: Children with ASD had elevated Skunavirus abundance and decreased gut DNA virome α diversity compared to their healthy siblings, while no significant differences were found in β diversity or the relative abundance of other viruses.
